value.rationale: Large-deviation fluctuations for the canonical full-height skew tent family are natural extensions of the cited symmetric tent-map study. The parameter continuum obeys the sharp, rigid H=6/5+(19/15)G^2 law and has no positive-skew parameter, a nontrivial dynamical shape classification rather than a numeric special case. In particular the symmetric map has zero covariance at every positive lag yet nonzero third and fourth temporal cumulant growth, distinguishing pairwise decorrelation from higher-order stochastic independence. This exact distinction is useful for finite-time non-Gaussian statistics and interprets the strength and direction of asymmetry.
